name: RS Q8
description: The Audi RS Q8 (2019–present) is the performance flagship of the SUV range — a 600 hp twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 in an SUV body. It shares its MLB Evo platform with the Lamborghini Urus and the Porsche Cayenne Turbo GT. The RS Q8 Nürburgring lap record (7:42) made it the fastest SUV at the circuit.
